Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.capture.provider

Class FFmpegCaptureProvider

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.capture.provider.FFmpegCaptureProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
CaptureProvider
@Component public class FFmpegCaptureProvider extends Object implements CaptureProvider
FFmpeg-based screen capture provider.

Captures screens at physical resolution, bypassing Java's DPI awareness. This ensures consistent captures regardless of Java version or DPI settings.

Since:
